thesis: NO ENTRY. The account is flat, so no manage or close applies, and this run is ON TIME (slot 22:00 MYT, decision written 22:10 MYT / 14:10Z, ten minutes after the slot and well inside the 45-minute window), so the late-run rule does not decide this check on its own for the first time since the stall. The question was decided on the evidence, and it was decided inside the check itself by the market. THE CANDIDATE: XRPUSDT presented the best-looking setup the experiment has seen. It broke a genuine 30-DAY HIGH - the maximum daily high over the preceding 30 sessions excluding today is 1.5701 (09-21), and the 13:55Z 5m bar printed 1.5875/1.5876 on a +1.516% thrust closing at its high. The higher-timeframe trend agreed: the daily sequence runs 09-18 +7.781%, 09-19 +1.010%, 09-20 -0.035%, 09-21 +8.994%, 09-22 +2.825%, and the 4h chart shows a clean ascending low sequence 1.3871, 1.3938, 1.4042, 1.4143, 1.4383, 1.4765, 1.4814, 1.5041, 1.4939, 1.5142, 1.5306 with the 09-22 00:00 pullback bar (-1.367%) completed and the 08:00 and 12:00 bars resuming at +1.265% and +2.778%. Relative strength was extreme (+6.197% over 24h against BTC +0.888%, ETH +0.883%, BNB -0.621%, SOL -0.499%). Funding was the only negative rate in the complex at -0.019946% against the 0.0100% baseline on BTC/ETH/SOL and 0.0000% on BNB, with the perp mark 1.58037 sitting ABOVE the 1.57965 mid - a perp discount during a rally, so a long would have RECEIVED funding at the 16:00Z settlement. The spread was 3.17 bps against the 25 bps cap, and the artifact scan found XRPUSDT completely clean at both 5m and 1h. Crucially, a 30-day high means CLEAN AIR ABOVE: for the first time in this experiment a passing target would not have had to jump two or three intervening levels, which is the objection that killed the 00:00, 02:00 and 09:00 constructions. THE ARITHMETIC NEVERTHELESS REPRODUCED THE DISTANCE PROBLEM EXACTLY. Re-implementing the engine's own formula (5 bps fee and 2 bps slippage per side, entry = ask * 1.0002 = 1.580216 from the 14:05Z ask of 1.5799): a stop at 1.5690, just below the broken 1.5701 high, is 0.710% away and clears the floor at a target of only 1.6039 (+1.499%, the measured move off the 1.5489/1.4939 base) for a net 1.661. But 0.710% is LESS THAN HALF the 1.534% range of the single 5m bar that made the breakout and roughly half a typical recent hourly range (12:00 0.928%, 11:00 1.456%, 10:00 1.313%, 08:00 2.291%) - that is trap (a) from the 02:00 note, a stop that is a size rather than a stop. The honest structural stop is 1.5470, below the double-touched 1.5476 low of the 13:35 and 13:45 bars and beyond the level that defines the setup, at 2.102% risk or 1.37x the largest 5m bar - and it pays only 0.509 to 1.6039, 1.079 to 1.6200, and needs roughly 1.636 (+3.53%) to reach 1.5, clearing properly only at the 1.6463 larger measured move (+4.182%, net 1.828). So once again the only construction that passed on a modest target did so on a noise-width stop, and the only noise-safe stop demanded a multi-percent reach. THE MARKET THEN SETTLED IT WITHIN THE CHECK, AND IT SETTLED IT AGAINST THE LONG. Between the first quote at 14:05Z and the confirming sweep at 14:09Z - four minutes - XRPUSDT fell from 1.5794/1.5799 to 1.5715/1.5716, and the 14:05Z 5m bar printed O1.5799 H1.5799 L1.5699 C1.5715 on 552,264,819 of volume. Price traded to 1.5699, BACK BELOW the 1.5701 level it had just broken, fifteen minutes after breaking it. The 1.5690 stop that made the tight construction 'pass' would have come within 0.0009 of being taken out inside the same check that proposed it - trap (a) demonstrated in real time rather than argued. This is precisely the case the strategy's session-timing rule names: a breakout that has not held is not evidence yet, and at 22:00-22:10 MYT we are thirty to forty minutes past the 21:30 US open, inside the erratic window that rule describes. VOLUME NEVER CONFIRMED THE BREAKOUT AT ANY POINT, and this is the reason the setup was thin even before it failed. On the hourly timeframe the breakout hour (13:00Z, +2.971%) traded 3.908B USDT against 4.030B in the flat 11:00 hour and 4.026B in the 08:00 hour - XRPUSDT's hourly volume sits in a 3.5-4.0B band every single hour regardless of price action, so it carries no directional information at all. On 5m the breakout bar's 625,770,303 was only the SECOND heaviest of the last thirty bars; the heaviest, 707,658,833 at 13:25Z, was a DOWN bar, and the failure bar at 14:05Z traded 552,264,819, nearly matching the breakout itself. The volume category therefore could not be claimed for the long and is recorded here as evidence AGAINST it. WHAT REMAINED WAS NOT INDEPENDENT ENOUGH. Stripping price_action (an unconfirmed and now failed breakout) and volume (absent, then adverse) leaves trend, market_context and derivatives. Trend and market_context here are largely the SAME observation drawn over the same candles - XRP has risen a lot recently, more than the others - and the strategy is explicit that a moving average and a trend line over the same candles are one observation, not two. Derivatives remains degraded to funding alone because /futures/data/openInterestHist still returns the bare string 'ok' with no history, and the -0.019946% reading is small in absolute terms. The strategy's instruction is that when in doubt, no_trade is a valid and common outcome, and the doubt here was resolved against the trade by the tape. WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS TRADEABLE, for the 23:00 check: a HOLD and retest above 1.5701 that forms a pullback low ABOVE that level would place a structural stop just beneath the retest low - both noise-safe and close - which is the first construction that would actually SOLVE the distance problem rather than work around it. That is worth waiting one hour for. BTCUSDT is excluded for a seventh consecutive check on artifacts.
